verdict.rationale: Trello's own support docs list "Import data into Trello" among its Power-Up features, which is a first-party import capability. That is the only evidence, a single heading with no detail on which source tools, file formats, or data types (cards, lists, members, attachments) are supported. Missing for 10: supported source tools or formats, what data carries over, step-by-step import docs, independent or hands-on confirmation of a migration.
